{{Top|leg|canon=Glor-ag}}
A '''glor'ag''' was a type of creature. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Borun Call]] was proficient in riding glor'ags<ref name="WBC">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref> by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] was compiled in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], as [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]] establishes that it was made three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Glor'ags were first mentioned in an article in the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" series that was written by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]] in [[May]] [[1996]].<ref name="WBC" />
